goal: drive the resident persistent-runtime firmware full request (API call -> first active speech packet) below the 60,000,000 executed-instruction line with byte-identical outputs

reproducible_rebuild.note: rebuilding after reverting the experimental field-name cache reproduced exactly the same ELF SHA256 (2118790e4ce4facc632c694344d41a493ae5f2f87f25bb063d666fb746c52535)

sram_sections.note: whole zh dictionary page image inflated at boot

changes: frontend_source/zh_tables.c: boot-time whole-dictionary page image (2439 pages, 1,516,448 bytes) in SRAM; per-request lookups read the prewarmed page directly
frontend_source/zh_t2s.c: first-byte dispatch index for traditional->simplified phrase matching (removes full phrase-list scan per position)

frontend_source/bridge.c + src/text_frontend.c: state-only reference pipeline (no scratch string formatting); targeted zeroing of only the used N25TextFeatures entries instead of the full ~132 KiB struct
frontend_source/zh_tables.c: inlined bytewise key compare for the dictionary page binary search (replaces strcmp/strncmp/memchr in the search)
carried from earlier resident rounds: counter-neutralized fast_math/gru_fusion/fargan_stream/fir_fast/adapter_stream, neutralized quality.c counters, opt9-opt12 kernels

profiling.plugin: GPL QEMU instruction-event plugin, single-vCPU mps3-an547 Cortex-M55, Architectural instruction events, not cycles

rejected_experiment.name: global field-name cache
rejected_experiment.result: slower (61.36M full scope); reverted, rebuild reproduced the opt16 ELF exactly

milestone.meaning: For this ordinary Chinese benchmark request the resident firmware executes 59,988,134 architectural instructions between the API call and the first active 20 ms speech packet. At the extreme optimistic 1 IPC line this is 299.94 ms. Real M55 cycles are higher (in-order core, MVE 64-bit operations occupy two beats, loads/branches add cycles), so hardware 300 ms is NOT yet accepted.

remaining_work: build a cycle model and/or measure real M55 cycles to replace the 1 IPC accounting line
widen the margin: per-layer resolved tensor pointers (avoid namefmt in hot loops without a global linear cache), dictionary row index, request-path micro cuts
verify longer/different texts because the margin depends on text length and dictionary pages touched
re-verify complete-system ROM/RAM dual 10 MB with the added 1.45 MB dictionary image
not_claimed: calibrated 200 MHz cycles or hardware 300ms acceptance
